requirements.title: The binding record
requirements.rationale: Hub must own the binding because apikit's pats table cannot be changed.

criteria.action: keep bindings in the SQLite table token_workspace_bindings with columns token_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL and created_at TEXT NOT NULL (an apikit.NowUTC timestamp), an index idx_token_workspace_bindings_slug on slug, and no foreign key to workspaces
criteria.contract: the table token_workspace_bindings exists with columns token_id TEXT (primary key), slug TEXT NOT NULL and created_at TEXT NOT NULL; the index idx_token_workspace_bindings_slug exists on slug; PRAGMA foreign_key_list(token_workspace_bindings) returns no rows; a row inserted with apikit.NowUTC() as created_at is read back unchanged

setup: an empty in-memory SQLite database
check.pseudocode: err = InitBindingSchema(db); assert err == nil; cols = pragma_table_info('token_workspace_bindings'); assert names(cols)==['token_id','slug','created_at']; assert pk(token_id) and notnull(slug) and notnull(created_at); assert 'idx_token_workspace_bindings_slug' in index_list; assert len(pragma_foreign_key_list)==0

criteria.condition: the binding schema initialisation runs on a database where token_workspace_bindings already exists
criteria.action: complete using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS and leave every existing row unchanged
criteria.contract: returns a nil error; the row count before and after is equal

setup: token_workspace_bindings exists and holds two rows
check.pseudocode: insert('t1','a',now); insert('t2','b',now); before = select_all(); assert InitBindingSchema(db)==nil; assert select_all()==before

criteria.condition: MountWorkspaceHandlers runs
criteria.action: create the binding table right after the workspaces schema and before any route is registered
criteria.contract: the table exists before the first request is served

setup: a real apikit server and a fresh apikit database with no token_workspace_bindings table
check.pseudocode: err = MountWorkspaceHandlers(srv, db); assert err==nil; assert table_exists(db.SqlDB,'token_workspace_bindings'); assert rowid('token_workspace_bindings') > rowid('workspaces')

criteria.condition: MountGitHandlers runs on a database that lacks token_workspace_bindings
criteria.action: create the binding table before registering the git routes
criteria.contract: a PAT carrying a TokenID with no binding row is served by the git server without a 500

setup: a test database with workspaces and pats tables but no token_workspace_bindings table
a workspace owned by the PAT's user with a cloned repository
an unbound PAT carrying a TokenID with git:read
check.pseudocode: assert MountGitHandlers(e, db, root)==nil; assert table_exists(db,'token_workspace_bindings'); r = get('/git/org/ws.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack', basic(pat)); assert r.status==200

criteria.condition: creating the binding table fails in MountWorkspaceHandlers or MountGitHandlers
criteria.action: return the error from the mount function without registering further routes
criteria.contract: MountWorkspaceHandlers or MountGitHandlers returns a non-nil error

setup: a database on which the binding DDL fails, for example an index named token_workspace_bindings already exists
for MountWorkspaceHandlers the workspaces schema itself succeeds
check.pseudocode: exec('CREATE INDEX token_workspace_bindings ON other(x)'); assert MountGitHandlers(e, db, root) != nil; assert len(e.Routes())==before; assert MountWorkspaceHandlers(srv, apikitDB) != nil

criteria.condition: a workspace is archived or deleted
criteria.action: leave every binding row that names its slug unchanged
criteria.contract: the token_workspace_bindings row count and contents are equal before and after the archive or delete

setup: a workspace S owned by user u1
binding rows for two tokens naming S and one naming another slug
check.pseudocode: seed 3 rows; snap = rows(); archive('S'); assert rows()==snap; delete('S'); assert rows()==snap

criteria.action: treat a PAT whose token id has no row in token_workspace_bindings as unbound
criteria.contract: LookupBinding returns slug "", bound false, nil error; BoundSlug returns bound false and a nil error; LookupBinding for tokB returns the bound slug and true

setup: an initialised binding table with a row only for token tokB
check.pseudocode: slug,bound,err = LookupBinding(db,'tokX'); assert !bound and err==nil

requirements.title: Resolving a binding
requirements.rationale: Every enforcing layer must agree on which token id is checked and must fail closed on a lookup error.

criteria.action: consider a binding only for an AuthInfo with CredentialType "pat" and key the lookup by AuthInfo.TokenID, issuing no binding query for api_key and admin_token credentials or a nil AuthInfo
criteria.contract: every call returns bound false and a nil error, which proves no query was issued; with a working database a PAT with TokenID is looked up by that TokenID

setup: a database handle that has been closed, so any query would return an error
a binding table that would otherwise hold rows
check.pseudocode: db.Close(); for a in [apiKey, admin, nil, patNoTokenID]: s,b,err = BoundSlug(db,a); assert !b and err==nil

criteria.condition: a PAT request has passed apikit authentication on an API-group route and AuthInfo.TokenID is empty
criteria.action: take the token id from the Authorization header (scheme Bearer matched case-insensitively, the text between af_pat_ and the next _) and write the enriched AuthInfo back with apikit.SetAuthInfo
criteria.contract: apikit.GetAuthInfo in the handler returns the same AuthInfo with TokenID set to the parsed id

setup: a binding row for token id abc123 naming S
a test auth middleware that sets a PAT AuthInfo with empty TokenID
the binding guard behind that middleware and a probe handler that records apikit.GetAuthInfo(c)
check.pseudocode: h = guard(db)(probe); req.Header.Set('Authorization','bearer af_pat_abc123_secret'); serve; assert probe.auth.TokenID=='abc123' and probe.auth.UserID==orig.UserID

criteria.condition: no token id can be derived for a PAT (TokenID empty and the Authorization header missing, not of the form Bearer af_pat_<id>_<secret>, or with an empty id)
criteria.action: treat the PAT as unbound without issuing a binding query
criteria.contract: the request proceeds exactly as for an unbound PAT

setup: a closed database handle so any query would fail with an error
a PAT AuthInfo with empty TokenID
the binding guard and a probe handler
check.pseudocode: for h in headers: r = serve(h); assert r.status == probe_status and probe.called

criteria.action: resolve a binding with exactly one primary-key lookup on token_id per enforcing layer, never while a rows cursor or transaction is open on the same database handle
criteria.contract: on a single-connection (SetMaxOpenConns(1)) SQLite database every enforcing call returns within 5 seconds

setup: an in-memory SQLite database with SetMaxOpenConns(1)
workspaces S and X owned by u1 and a binding row for token tokB naming S
check.pseudocode: db.SetMaxOpenConns(1); for call in calls: ok = within(5s, call); assert ok

criteria.condition: the binding lookup returns a database error
criteria.action: fail closed and never treat the token as unbound
criteria.contract: API routes answer HTTP 500 with message internal server error and the handler does not run; LookupBinding returns a non-nil error

setup: a PAT with a TokenID and a database whose token_workspace_bindings table has been dropped
check.pseudocode: drop table; _,_,err = LookupBinding(db,'t'); assert err!=nil; r = serve(guard(probe)); assert r.status==500 and r.msg=='internal server error' and !probe.called

requirements.title: Workspace-scoped API routes
requirements.rationale: To a bound token, every workspace other than S must not exist, regardless of scopes.

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route whose path template contains the segments workspaces/:slug and :slug is not S
criteria.action: refuse the request before the handler runs, and so before any scope, existence or status check
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with the apikit error envelope and message workspace not found, the same body a non-owner receives

setup: token tokB bound to S with no scopes at all
routes GET /workspaces/:slug and GET /workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/events behind the guard
check.pseudocode: r = get('/workspaces/X'); assert r.status==404 and r.json.error.message=='workspace not found' and !handler.called

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route whose path template contains the segments workspaces/:slug and :slug equals S
criteria.action: pass the request unchanged into the handler's own checks
criteria.contract: the status and body equal those an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes receives

setup: workspace S owned by u1
bound token tokB and unbound token tokU for u1 with identical scopes (once with workspaces:read, once without)
check.pseudocode: assert resp(tokB).status==resp(tokU).status and resp(tokB).body==resp(tokU).body

criteria.action: for any bound token, any slug other than S, any workspace-scoped route and any scope set (including none), whether the slug exists, is owned or is archived, answer 404 workspace not found
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with message workspace not found, body identical to a non-owner's

setup: token bound to S
workspace-scoped routes registered on the guarded group
check.pseudocode: for slug,route,scopes in gen(): r = call(boundTok(scopes), route(slug)); assert r.status==404 and r.body==nonOwnerBody and !handler.called

criteria.action: install the binding guard with s.APIGroup().Use inside MountWorkspaceHandlers after MountHandlers and before RegisterRoutes, so that every route and subgroup registered on the API group afterwards, including /workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id, is guarded without further change
criteria.contract: both answers are 404 workspace not found; with slug S the request reaches the audit handler

setup: MountWorkspaceHandlers called on a real apikit server
audit.RegisterRoutes then registered on server.APIGroup() afterwards
a bound token for S
check.pseudocode: MountWorkspaceHandlers(srv,db); audit.RegisterRoutes(srv.APIGroup(),...); api.GET('/workspaces/:slug/new', h); assert post(X runs).status==404; assert get(new route X).status==404

criteria.condition: wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace is called with a bound PAT for an existing workspace the caller owns and the slug is not S
criteria.action: apply the binding rule after the existence and ownership checks and deny access
criteria.contract: returns (nil, 404, "workspace not found"); for slug S it returns the same access value as for an unbound PAT

setup: owned workspaces S and X for u1
bound PAT with TokenID tokB naming S
check.pseudocode: a,code,msg = AuthorizeWorkspace(db,bound,'X'); assert a==nil and code==404 and msg=='workspace not found'; assert *AuthorizeWorkspace(db,bound,'S') == *AuthorizeWorkspace(db,unbound,'S')

criteria.condition: lookupWorkspaceForAuth is called with a bound PAT for an existing workspace the caller owns and the slug is not S
criteria.action: deny access through the shared wsaccess rule
criteria.contract: writes HTTP 404 workspace not found and returns a non-nil error

setup: owned workspaces S and X for u1
an echo context with a bound PAT AuthInfo naming S and no guard in front
check.pseudocode: ws,err = lookupWorkspaceForAuth(c,db,'X',bound); assert err!=nil and rec.Code==404

criteria.condition: the binding lookup inside wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace or lookupWorkspaceForAuth fails with a database error
criteria.action: deny access
criteria.contract: AuthorizeWorkspace returns (nil, 500, "internal server error"); lookupWorkspaceForAuth writes HTTP 500

setup: an existing workspace owned by u1
the token_workspace_bindings table dropped after seeding
a PAT with a TokenID
check.pseudocode: drop table; a,code,msg = AuthorizeWorkspace(db,pat,'S'); assert code==500 and msg=='internal server error'

requirements.title: Default-deny for other hub API routes
requirements.rationale: A route nobody thought to confine must refuse a bound token rather than leak other workspaces.

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route that is not workspace-scoped and the route's method and path template are not on the bound-token allowlist
criteria.action: refuse the request before the handler runs
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to workspace <S>

setup: a route GET /widgets not on the allowlist, behind the guard
token bound to S with any scopes
check.pseudocode: r = get('/widgets'); assert r.status==403 and r.json.error.error_type=='token_bound' and r.json.error.message=='this token is bound to workspace S'

criteria.action: provide an allowlist registry fed with the *echo.Route values returned at registration and keyed by method plus path template, marked for exactly GET /workspaces, POST /sessions, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id, POST /sessions/:id/complete, POST /sessions/:id/usage, GET /sessions/:id/usage, GET /audit, GET /events and GET /sandbox-profiles
criteria.contract: the allowed set equals exactly GET /workspaces, POST /sessions, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id, POST /sessions/:id/complete, POST /sessions/:id/usage, GET /sessions/:id/usage, GET /audit, GET /events and GET /sandbox-profiles; POST /workspaces and GET /sandboxes are not in it

setup: an Echo group on which workspace, audit, sandboxes, secrets, merge, forge and carrypatch RegisterRoutes have all been called as in main
check.pseudocode: allowed = [r for r in routes if wsaccess.IsAllowed(r.Method,r.Path)]; assert set(allowed)==EXPECTED10

criteria.condition: a bound token requests an API-group route that is not workspace-scoped and the route is on the bound-token allowlist
criteria.action: pass the request to the handler, which filters its result to S
criteria.contract: the handler runs; its response follows 33-REQ-6

setup: GET /listing marked with AllowBoundTokens
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: AllowBoundTokens(api.GET('/listing',h)); r=get('/listing'); assert h.called and r.status==200

criteria.condition: a bound token requests POST /workspaces, any /user/secrets or /user/vars route, any /orgs/:slug/secrets or /orgs/:slug/vars route, or GET /sandboxes
criteria.action: refuse the request whatever scopes the token holds
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound; no row is written

setup: real workspace, secrets and sandboxes routes registered behind the guard
a bound token holding workspaces:create, secrets and vars scopes
row counts of workspaces, secrets and variables
check.pseudocode: for (m,p) in cases: r=call(m,p); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound'; assert counts()==before

criteria.condition: a bound token requests a path under the API mount point that matches no registered route
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound

setup: the guard installed on the API group
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: r = get('/api/v1/no/such/path'); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound'

criteria.action: for any route registered on the API group after the guard that is neither workspace-scoped nor marked on the allowlist, refuse a bound token with 403 token_bound
criteria.contract: the bound token receives 403 token_bound; the route's handler is never called

setup: the guard installed first
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: for m,p in gen_templates(): api.Add(m,p,h); r=call(m,p); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound' and !h.called

criteria.condition: a request without credentials, or with an api_key, admin_token or unbound PAT credential, reaches the binding guard
criteria.action: pass the request to the next handler, issuing no binding query for requests without credentials, api_key or admin_token
criteria.contract: status and body equal those produced without the guard

setup: a guard in front of a probe handler
a closed binding database for the no-credential, api_key and admin_token cases (a query would produce a 500)
a working database for the unbound PAT case
check.pseudocode: for a in [none,apiKey,admin,unboundPat]: assert guarded(a)==unguarded(a)

requirements.title: Guarding apikit's own routes
requirements.rationale: A bound PAT holding tokens:manage could otherwise mint an unbound PAT through apikit's POST /user/tokens.

criteria.condition: MountWorkspaceHandlers calls s.MountHandlers
criteria.action: record as apikit routes the method and path template of every route in s.Echo().Routes() after the call that was absent before it, leaving out /healthz, /readyz and /version
criteria.contract: the recorded set includes GET <mount>/user and POST <mount>/user/tokens

setup: a real apikit server whose Echo route table is snapshotted before and after MountHandlers
check.pseudocode: set = recordedAPIKitRoutes(); assert ('GET',mount+'/user') in set and ('POST',mount+'/user/tokens') in set; assert not any(p in ['/healthz','/readyz','/version'])

criteria.condition: a request's method and path template match a recorded apikit route and it carries Authorization: Bearer af_pat_<token_id>_<secret> and <token_id> has a binding row
criteria.action: refuse the request on the root Echo instance before apikit authenticates it, without naming the workspace
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type token_bound and message this token is bound to a workspace; the slug does not appear in the body

setup: a real apikit server with MountWorkspaceHandlers
a PAT minted through apikit and a binding row for its id naming workspace secret-ws
check.pseudocode: for (m,p) in cases: r=call(m,p,boundPat); assert r.status==403 and r.msg=='this token is bound to a workspace' and 'secret-ws' not in r.body

criteria.condition: a bound PAT holding tokens:manage sends POST /api/v1/user/tokens
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 token_bound; no new PAT is created in apikit's pats table

setup: a real apikit server with a bound PAT holding tokens:manage
the count of rows in apikit's pats table
check.pseudocode: n=count(pats); r=post('/api/v1/user/tokens',body,boundPat); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='token_bound'; assert count(pats)==n

criteria.condition: a request matching a recorded apikit route carries no af_pat_ Bearer token or carries one whose id has no binding row
criteria.action: pass the request to apikit unchanged, issuing no binding query when no af_pat_ id is present
criteria.contract: status and body equal those apikit produces without the guard

setup: the apikit route guard with a recorded route GET /api/v1/user
a closed database for the cases with no af_pat_ id
check.pseudocode: assert guarded(req)==unguarded(req) for each

criteria.action: only refuse or pass through: never grant access, never set AuthInfo and never hash or verify a token secret
criteria.contract: the bound id is refused 403 regardless of secret correctness; the unbound id reaches the probe where apikit.GetAuthInfo(c) is nil; the guard source does not import a hashing or token verification package

setup: the apikit route guard before a probe handler
a bound token id with a wrong secret and an unbound id with a wrong secret
check.pseudocode: assert probe.auth==nil for unbound; assert refused(bound,wrongSecret)==refused(bound,rightSecret)

criteria.condition: a request does not match a recorded apikit route
criteria.action: pass the request through without a binding query
criteria.contract: zero binding queries for that request at the root guard

setup: the apikit route guard on a closed database
a recorded route set
check.pseudocode: db.Close(); r=serve('/api/v1/workspaces',bearer); assert r.status != 500

criteria.condition: the apikit route guard's binding lookup fails with a database error
criteria.action: fail closed and not forward the request to apikit
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

setup: a recorded apikit route and the binding table dropped
check.pseudocode: r=serve(); assert r.status==500 and r.msg=='internal server error' and !next.called

requirements.title: Cross-workspace views and sessions
requirements.rationale: A service needs to discover its workspace, report sessions and read its audit stream, yet must see only S.

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /workspaces
criteria.action: return at most workspace S, subject to the existing workspaces:read scope check and the include_archived filter
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 whose list contains S or nothing; other refusals unchanged

setup: u1 owns S, X (active) and A (archived) and A is S in the archived variant
bound token with workspaces:read, a second bound token without it
check.pseudocode: r=get('/workspaces'); assert slugs(r)==['S']; assert get('/workspaces',noScopeTok).status==403

criteria.condition: a bound token sends POST /sessions with a workspace_slug other than S, or replays a session id that belongs to another workspace
criteria.action: refuse through requireWorkspaceRead and create no session
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found

setup: workspaces S and X owned by u1
a session id already created in X by u1
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: r=post('/sessions',{workspace_slug:'X'}); assert r.status==404 and r.msg=='workspace not found'; assert count(sessions)==before

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /sessions/:id or GET /sessions/:id/usage for a session outside S, or GET /sessions?workspace_slug=<slug other than S>
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 workspace access denied

setup: a session in X and a session in S
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: for p in paths: r=get(p); assert r.status==403 and r.msg=='workspace access denied'

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /sessions without workspace_slug
criteria.action: list only sessions of workspace S
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 whose items all carry workspace_slug S

setup: sessions in S and X for u1
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: r=get('/sessions'); assert r.status==200 and all(i.workspace_slug=='S' for i in r.items) and len(r.items)>0

criteria.condition: a bound token sends POST /sessions/:id/complete or POST /sessions/:id/usage for a session whose workspace is not S
criteria.action: refuse the request, with RegisterSessionRoutes passing the SQLite handle to both handlers, and leave the session unchanged
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 not session owner

setup: an active session in X created by the same user (credential id equal to the bound token's user)
RegisterSessionRoutes given the SQLite handle
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: r=post('/sessions/'+id+'/complete'); assert r.status==403 and r.msg=='not session owner'; assert session(id).status=='active'

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /audit or GET /events
criteria.action: return only events of workspace S
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 (or the SSE stream) whose events all carry workspace S

setup: audit events in S and X for u1
token bound to S
check.pseudocode: assert all(e.workspace=='S' for e in get('/audit').events); assert all(e.workspace=='S' for e in read_sse('/events'))

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /audit?workspace=<slug other than S>
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found

setup: owned workspace X and token bound to S
check.pseudocode: r=get('/audit?workspace=X'); assert r.status==404 and r.msg=='workspace not found'

criteria.condition: a bound token sends GET /sandbox-profiles
criteria.action: answer exactly as for an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes
criteria.contract: status and body equal the unbound PAT's

setup: sandboxes.RegisterRoutes mounted behind the guard
a bound and an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes
check.pseudocode: assert resp(bound)==resp(unbound)

requirements.title: The git server
requirements.rationale: Git access must honour the same binding as the REST API.

criteria.condition: a bound token requests a repository /git/<org>/<slug>.git through authorizeGitAccess and <slug> is not S
criteria.action: deny access after the admin and ownership checks
criteria.contract: pkt-line 404 repository not found, identical to a non-owner's response

setup: workspaces S and X owned by u1 with repositories
bound PAT for S with git:read, and a non-owner PAT
check.pseudocode: assert body(boundFetchX)==body(nonOwnerFetchX) and status==404

criteria.condition: a bound token requests the repository of workspace S and the caller owns S
criteria.action: let the existing git:read and git:write scope checks decide
criteria.contract: fetch and push outcomes equal those of an unbound PAT with the same scopes

setup: bound PAT and unbound PAT of the same user, both with only git:read, and both with git:read+git:write

criteria.condition: the git server's binding lookup fails with a database error
criteria.action: fail closed
criteria.contract: pkt-line 500 error; the repository is not served

setup: the binding table dropped
a PAT with TokenID that owns the repository
check.pseudocode: r=get(info/refs); assert r.status==500 and pktline_error(r.body)

criteria.condition: an api_key or admin_token credential requests a git repository
criteria.action: apply the existing checks without a binding query
criteria.contract: response identical to that before this spec

setup: the binding table dropped (any query would give a 500)
an owned repository
check.pseudocode: assert fetch(apiKeyOwner).status==200 and fetch(admin).status==200 and fetch(nonOwner).status==404

requirements.title: Audit ingestion
requirements.rationale: The KeyID branch of checkWorkspaceAccess assumed a binding nothing produced; the shared rule replaces it.

criteria.action: decide workspace access in checkWorkspaceAccess without reading auth.KeyID and never emit error_type workspace_mismatch
criteria.contract: the event is accepted; no response carries error_type workspace_mismatch; the source of checkWorkspaceAccess contains no KeyID reference

criteria.action: refuse the request and write no event
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found

setup: token bound to S via a binding row (rewritten TS-17-51)
owned workspace X
check.pseudocode: r=post('/workspaces/X/runs/r1/events'); assert r.status==404 and count(events)==0

criteria.condition: an unbound non-owner posts to a run of a workspace
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type workspace_access_denied

setup: workspace owned by u2
an unbound PAT of u1
check.pseudocode: r=post(run, u1); assert r.status==403 and r.error_type=='workspace_access_denied'

criteria.condition: the caller posts to a run of an archived workspace it may reach

criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error_type workspace_archived

setup: an archived workspace owned by u1
no workspace named ghost

criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 404

criteria.condition: the audit routes are registered with a nil SQLite handle
criteria.action: skip the workspace access checks
criteria.contract: the event is accepted as before this spec

setup: audit routes registered with a nil SQLite handle
check.pseudocode: env=newAuditTestEnv(); r=post(events); assert r.status==201

requirements.title: Unchanged behaviour and lifecycle
requirements.rationale: The binding may only narrow a bound token's reach; it must never move existing behaviour.

criteria.action: for any request by an unbound PAT, an API key or an admin token, return a status and body byte-identical to those without this spec, so that the ownership suites of internal/workspace, gitserver, carrypatch, merge, sandboxes, forge, secrets and audit pass unchanged except the two audit tests encoding the KeyID check
criteria.contract: status code and body bytes are equal between the two hubs

setup: two identical hubs: one with the guards and one without
no binding rows
check.pseudocode: for cred,route,slug in gen(): assert call(guarded,cred,route,slug)==call(plain,cred,route,slug)

criteria.action: issue zero binding queries for requests authenticated with an api_key or admin_token credential
criteria.contract: none of the responses is a 500 caused by a binding lookup; responses equal those from before this spec

setup: a real hub with the binding table dropped after mount (any query yields 500)
check.pseudocode: drop table; for cred in [apiKey,admin]: for req in reqs: assert call(cred,req).status != 500

criteria.action: for any bound token, route and slug, allow a request only if an unbound PAT with the same user and scopes would be allowed it, so that a binding never widens a scope
criteria.contract: if the bound token's request is not refused by the guard (status not 404/403 token_bound), the unbound PAT's response has the same status and body; no 2xx for the bound token has a non-2xx for the unbound PAT

setup: a bound token and an unbound PAT with identical user and scopes
check.pseudocode: for scopes,route,slug in gen(): b=call(bound); u=call(unbound); if 200<=b.status<300: assert u.status==b.status

criteria.condition: a bound token's workspace S is archived
criteria.action: let the token reach S and return that workspace's usual archived responses
criteria.contract: the same 400 or 409 an unbound owner PAT receives on S

bound and unbound owner PATs with the same scopes
check.pseudocode: assert resp(bound,'PATCH','/workspaces/S')==resp(unbound,'PATCH','/workspaces/S')

criteria.condition: a bound token's workspace S has been deleted and its binding row remains
criteria.action: fail closed for the token
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found on every workspace-scoped route, HTTP 403 token_bound on every other non-allowlisted route, and pkt-line 404 repository not found in git

setup: a binding row naming S and S deleted
a bound PAT
check.pseudocode: assert get('/workspaces/S').status==404; assert get('/user/secrets').error_type=='token_bound'; assert git_fetch('S').status==404

execution_paths.title: A bound token reads its own workspace and is refused another

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/S with Authorization: Bearer af_pat_<id>_<secret>
authenticates the PAT and sets AuthInfo
fills AuthInfo.TokenID if empty, looks up the binding, sees :slug equals S and passes the request on
calls lookupWorkspaceForAuth, which applies ownership and the binding rule, and returns 200 with workspace S
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/X/patches for another owned workspace X
answers 404 workspace not found before the handler runs

setup: a real apikit server with a real database and MountWorkspaceHandlers
users's PAT minted through apikit with workspaces:read
workspaces S and X owned by the user and a binding row for the PAT naming S
end_state: the first answer is 200 with workspace S
the second is 404 workspace not found
the unbound twin PAT gets 200 on both

execution_paths.title: A bound token tries to mint an unbound PAT through apikit

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/user/tokens with a bound PAT holding tokens:manage
matches the route against the apikit route set recorded at startup and parses the token id from the Bearer header
finds a binding row and answers 403 token_bound with message this token is bound to a workspace
remains without a new token

authenticates the PAT

returns a list holding only S
sends POST /api/v1/sessions with workspace_slug S
creates the session and returns 201
sends GET /api/v1/audit
returns only events of S

resolves the PAT and sets AuthInfo.TokenID
calls authorizeGitAccess, which passes ownership and the binding, then the git:read scope check, and serves the pack
fetches /git/<org>/X.git for another owned workspace X
writes a pkt-line 404 repository not found
